messages.subject: [inlinedocs] individual sections within the documentation?
messages.body_plain:
Dear Inlinedocs Development Team, 

first, I may thank you for this great package. 

Although, I just started switching from the 'conventional' way to produce
documentations to inlinedocs, I think it is a great contribution. 

I have a question on the usage:

Writing own Rd-files allows for defining individual sections, e.g. 
\section{Version}{0.1}.

Is this also possible with inlinedocs, and if yes, can you provide a
short example? I tried many combinations with the inlinedocs code but
nothing worked for me (i.e. nothing was finally shown in the manual). 

Many thanks in advance and best wishes, 

Sebastian Kreutzer

messages.subject: [inlinedocs] individual sections within the documentation?
messages.body_plain:
Sorry for the delayed response. I don't think this is currently
possible with inlinedocs.

However, if you want to add this feature to inlinedocs, I could
certainly add you to the R-Forge project.

Otherwise, if you really need to define individual sections in Rd, I
think you should check out roxygen or just use plain Rd.
